components: Affine-covariant, diagonal-fixing contacts on five tags square to wire swap. The three-cell contact word ABAB has period six on nonconstant triples, but its third power is a common affine reflection, invisible to a frame-invariant reader of the isolated triple.

A supplied center defect, reference, two fair skip-or-step choices and first-wire equality now or after one inverse pulse give the six-count row. The older end-defect two-delayed-visit reader fails; a single affine scalar cannot act as the two-value latch on this orbit.

The fixed-stock, fixed-reader contact census screens all twenty order-six maps of the native GL2(5) action. The complete solo row leaves only the chosen pulse and its inverse. Prefix and unscreened interior calibration lookalikes are retained as controls; neither target calibration is jointly reached.
candidates.declared_status: Scoped finite process and observer construction, not a blind holdout, native equality latch or physical phase. Failure before complete calibration is not a missed held-out prediction at a reached calibration.
missing_bridges: Derive addressed contacts, defended preparation and a literal contact-event latch with a stable oriented reference, instead of reading the isolated affine orbit as an observed phase.
Establish an independently actuated second setting and justify the unchanged physical preparation and reader through full solo calibration before mixed-word comparison.

sources.text:
On two tags in Fp impose covariance under every affine change x -> ux+v
(u!=0), equality-diagonal fixing and T²=wire SWAP. The affine group acts
sharply transitively on ordered distinct pairs, so a gate is determined by
T(0,1)=(j,j+t). Its difference multiplier must obey t²=-1 and j(1+t)=1.
In F5 the two solutions are each other's inverse. Choose t=2: the same
gate T(x,y)=(4x+2y,2x+4y) is used on either neighboring pair. No six
tags, phase angle, table of probabilities or space coordinates enter it.

On three addressed cells let A=T01, B=T12, W=ABAB in chronological order.
All nonconstant triples have period six under W, even though one isolated
gate has order four. W³ reflects all tags about their common mean. With
only the triple and no oriented reference, that is a simultaneous affine
relabeling: no affine-invariant observation of the isolated triple can
distinguish these antipodes. A shared frame is not an observed phase.

Prepare (b,a,b) with a!=b, retain one local reference b, then supply two
independent fair choices of skipping or applying W. At the terminal reader
ask whether the first cell contacts the reference (is equal to b) now
OR after one reverse W step. This fixed two-visit reader uses only literal
comparisons, not a six-mark lookup; it gives one output bit per trial. No
reference is consulted mid-word. The reference, reliable equality event,
OR of contacts, addressing and preparation randomness are NOT derived.
The earlier end-defect/last-cell two-reverse-visit proposal fails; its
actual row is kept below. The center-defect arrangement is an alternative
construction, not a blind experimental holdout.

The readout gap is constructive: for the six states from a uniform
background plus one defect, any *single* nonconstant affine scalar readout
takes at least three distinct values; no raw affine circuit with fixed
additional cells can provide a nonconstant two-value latch even just on
this orbit. The code enumerates all affine line tests on its two-dimensional
constant-sum plane. This is not a wall on nonlinear detectors or another
primitive. Changing the frame (a,b) alone supplies no random skip history.

In F13 also test the distinct stronger single-relative-tag requirement:
(c+x,c-x,c) -> (c+4x,c-4x,c) by six elementary visits. Conservation of
the total tag forbids rotating only one uncompensated tag while restoring
all others. These are finite affine models, not quantum waves or particles;
in particular no occupation label, Born law or experimental counts appear.

def fringe_checks() -> None:
    for a, b in product(range(5), range(5)):
        if a == b:
            need(act((a, b, b), Six) == (a, b, b), "no-defect control moved")
            continue
        failed = cycle((a, b, b), Six)
        old_hits = [x[2] == b for x in failed]
        old_window = [old_hits[(n - 1) % 6] or old_hits[(n - 2) % 6] for n in range(6)]
        old_row = [
            sum(old_window[(n + i + k) % 6] for i, k in product(range(2), repeat=2))
            for n in range(6)
        ]
        need(old_row == [3, 3, 1, 0, 0, 1], "failed detector control")
        s = (b, a, b)
        six = cycle(s, Six)
        need(len(six) == 6, "wanted actual six distinct triples")
        need([int(x[0] == b) for x in six] == [1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0], "contact sequence")
        need([int(detector(x, b)) for x in six] == [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0], "window shift")
        rows = []
        for n in range(6):
            outputs = [
                int(detector(act(s, Six * (i + k + n)), b))
                for i, k in product(range(2), repeat=2)
            ]
            need(len(outputs) == 4, "lost a source history")
            rows.append(sum(outputs))
        need(rows == [4, 3, 1, 0, 1, 3], "all-emission finite fringe")
        # Constant-sum plane: for arbitrary output coordinate of an affine
        # circuit the third raw tag can be eliminated into an offset. An
        # affine line hits at most two points (also after adding fixed stock).
        all_ranges = set()
        for u, v in product(range(5), range(5)):
            if u or v:
                counts = Counter((u * x + v * y) % 5 for x, y, _ in six)
                all_ranges.add(len(counts))
                need(max(counts.values()) <= 2, "three orbit points collinear")
        need(min(all_ranges) >= 3, "raw binary readout escape")

Three active cells carry F5 labels; a fourth background reference is fixed
at zero. Primitive contacts L (cells 01), R (12) are (a,b)->(4a+2b,2a+4b).
A is the *whole* pulse LRLR in chronological order. Four equally weighted
histories start at s, As, As, A²s. The single frozen terminal detector is
bright if the FIRST wire is at background now OR after one inverse A. It
is never visited between pulse letters. This center-defect s=(0,1,0)
candidate was chosen after a failed end-defect/two-delayed-visit candidate;
that rejected apparatus is checked below rather than renamed a prediction.

All order-six maps are screened before mixed words; native means generated
by the two fixed contacts. A candidate B may use any finite contact word,
not necessarily the same length as A. Lowercase is the inverse of the
entire pulse. Existing rotation-comparison protocols are frozen in
probe_phase_pair_holdout.py: q=P(Ab) alone calibrates the supplied family;
q=1/2 and 3/4 have discriminating second holdouts. ABBB a is a separate
quadrature-calibration word (target 3/4); ABab is the group commutator
in the stated left-to-right convention, NOT that calibration.

Algebraic explanation: contacts preserve the common mean and are linear
on the 2-D deviation plane. The enumerated action is all GL2(5). An
order-six matrix has minimal polynomial X²-X+1: the field has no scalar
of order three, and X^6-1 is separable. Thus B³=-I for every such B;
all belong to one conjugacy class with centralizer F25* of order 24.
As -I is central, ABBB a is just B³ for every candidate, before the solo
filter. The readout here never reaches the separate quadrature calibration.
The complete six-count solo requirement rejects every noncommuting candidate
before an interior q may be assigned. This is not a failed mixed prediction
at a calibration that was reached. No claim about other stocks, detectors,
gate groups, larger periods hiding a six-step observable, or physics.

six = [
        g
        for g in group
        if power(g, 6) == IDENT and power(g, 2) != IDENT and power(g, 3) != IDENT
    ]
    need(len(six) == 20 and a in six, "order-six census")
    need(
        all(plane_matrix(power(g, 3)) == (4, 0, 0, 4) for g in six),
        "common central cube",
    )
    need(len({g for g in group if then(a, g) == then(g, a)}) == 24, "centralizer size")
    ai = power(a, 5)
    old_seed, seed = encode(1, 0, 0), encode(0, 1, 0)
    old = (old_seed, a[old_seed], a[old_seed], a[a[old_seed]])
    stock = (seed, a[seed], a[seed], a[a[seed]])
    old_detector = frozenset(
        i for i in IDENT if TAGS[ai[i]][2] == 0 or TAGS[ai[ai[i]]][2] == 0
    )
    detector = frozenset(i for i in IDENT if TAGS[i][0] == 0 or TAGS[ai[i]][0] == 0)
    need(
        tuple(measure(old, old_detector, power(a, n)) for n in range(6))
        == (3, 3, 1, 0, 0, 1),
        "rejected two-delayed-visit fixture changed",
    )
    # Freeze the entire solo screen before evaluating even the diagnostic mixed words.
    solos = {
        b: tuple(measure(stock, detector, power(b, n)) for n in range(6)) for b in six
    }
    prefix = [b for b in six if solos[b][:4] == FRINGE[:4]]
    survivors = {b for b in six if solos[b] == FRINGE}
    need(len(prefix) == 4 and survivors == {a, ai}, "truncated-vs-complete solo census")
    need(
        len([b for b in six if then(a, b) != then(b, a)]) == 18,
        "noncommuting stock alternatives",
    )
    need(
        all(solos[b] == (4, 3, 1, 0, 2, 0) for b in prefix if b not in survivors),
        "prefix countercontrols",
    )
    mixed_all: dict[Perm, tuple[int, ...]] = {}
    for b in six:
        commands = {"A": a, "a": ai, "B": b, "b": power(b, 5)}
        row = []
        for word in WORDS:
            g = IDENT
            for letter in word:
                g = then(g, commands[letter])
            if word == "ABBBa":
                need(g == power(a, 3), "common conjugate half turn")
            row.append(measure(stock, detector, g))
        mixed_all[b] = tuple(row)
    rows = {b: mixed_all[b] for b in survivors}
    need(
        rows == {a: (4, 1, 1, 0, 4), ai: (1, 4, 4, 0, 4)},
        "mixed rows for the exact survivors",
    )
    impostors = sorted((plane_matrix(b), mixed_all[b]) for b in prefix if b not in rows)
    all_q = Counter(row[0] for row in mixed_all.values())
    need(all_q == {0: 4, 1: 6, 2: 5, 3: 4, 4: 1}, "uncalibrated candidate counts")
    misleading = [
        b for b, r in mixed_all.items() if r[0] in (2, 3) and r[0] + r[1] == 5
    ]
    need(
        len(misleading) == 2
        and all(solos[b] == (4, 2, 3, 0, 3, 2) for b in misleading)
        and {mixed_all[b][:3] for b in misleading} == {(2, 3, 0), (3, 2, 4)},
        "unscreened interior/first-holdout matching is not joint calibration",
    )
